READING_r422.headline: under every noise condition tested -- including 30 fps, 30 deg camera yaw, +/-2 frame event error and 10 deg per-frame keypoint jitter -- leave-one-out classification accuracy never fell below 0.759, median 0.940 across all 216 conditions.
READING_r422.why_cycle_averaging_is_the_reason: the endpoint is a mean over 5-6 heel strikes, so i.i.d. per-frame jitter enters divided by sqrt(n_cycles) ~ 2.4. A published per-frame SEM cannot be read off as the endpoint's error; that is exactly why this analysis could not be replaced by citing a number.

THE_STATISTIC_TO_QUOTE_IS_NOT_DISJOINTNE.why: disjointness is an EXTREME-VALUE statistic over 10 cells -- one unlucky cell destroys it -- while accuracy uses the whole distribution. Disjointness is the right statistic for the noiseless mechanistic claim and the WRONG one for clinical translation. The paper must not quote 'disjoint' as if it were a clinical property.
THE_STATISTIC_TO_QUOTE_IS_NOT_DISJOINTNE.consequence: the clinical sentence is 'classifies at 94-97% under phone-grade video noise', NOT 'the two groups do not overlap'.

A_CONVENTION_SENSITIVITY_FOUND_IN_PASSIN.what_it_means: resampling the SAME .sto onto a uniform 60 Hz grid before reading the same endpoint moves the headline by +0.52 deg, with no noise added at all. The headline is therefore convention-dependent at the half-degree level and must be reported to one decimal place, not four, in any clinical sentence.
A_CONVENTION_SENSITIVITY_FOUND_IN_PASSIN.does_it_change_any_verdict: no. 6.39 and 6.92 sit on the same side of every threshold used in this corpus, and the batch-null comparator (largest same-mechanism gap 0.5697 deg) is an order of magnitude below both.

what_this_does_NOT_establish: the noise is i.i.d. Gaussian. Real markerless error is temporally correlated and biased under occlusion and extreme postures, so this UNDERSTATES real error -- stated in PREREG section 6.1.
leave-one-out accuracy over 10 cells has 10% granularity; the 0.94 median is coarse.
these are simulated arms, not patients. Nothing here is a validation.
cells within a family share an optimisation lineage; effective n is below 10.

VERDICT_FULL: All three registered predictions HOLD. The knee-at-heel-strike endpoint survives 2D markerless video noise as a CLASSIFIER (min accuracy 0.759 over 216 conditions, median 0.940, and 0.970 in the phone condition at sigma 2 deg) but NOT as a disjointness claim (disjointness falls below 95% at sigma 2 deg in the phone condition). The clinically reportable statistic is accuracy, not separation.
